parts.refutation: Three requirement rows fail, the same three the shortlist lists under 'failed': 'watchdog stop deadline (V1)', 'watchdog stall cover (V2)' and 'watchdog window (V1 and V2)'. None is a defect of the part. The watchdog takes any LOAD from 1 us to 0xffffff us, about 16.8 s (Table 1249). V1 is not found, so no timeout can be checked against it. V2 has no bound while a slow USB host keeps accepting data: pico-sdk 2.3.1 stdio_usb_out_chars() sets last_avail_time on every accepted chunk and breaks only 500,000 us after the last one. No timeout on any part exceeds an unbounded stall. The window needs V1. The other 44 rows and the allowlist check pass and agree with the datasheet. The RP2354B is a fixed input, so Research.md Scope sends a failed check to the owner, not to re-selection. FU-A2 adjudicator-R1 (022) ruled the same case: the refutation does not stand against the part.
